findings.finding: the dependency manifest omits runtime data files outside the configuration run directory (runtime audit): B -> runs/B/BASES/<learner>/S<s>/{MODEL.pkl,BASE.json}; INC complete release -> runs/INC/STEP1/S<s>/{STEP1.json,HGB_PO.pkl}, the witness's runs/B/B2_SINGLE/S<s>/STATE.json and BASES files, three mirror teacher / Stage-B files; PROT -> the witness's files and code; every package -> results/pcrl_income_headroom_successor_v1/SOURCE_ADMISSION.json (read by ihs admitted()). Runtime integrity still holds through each module's own hash chain, except that fam_b.predict never checks its own STATE.json, which INC and PROT packages reach unverified. A backup or restore driven by the manifest would miss these files.
findings.required_fix: derive the manifest from the runtime audit (or each module's declared dependencies), include the witness chain, and make fam_b.predict check STATE.json against OCC.json's state_sha256
findings.status: partly fixed by the coordinator (5fb9d494a: PROT witness run directory and module; INC Step-1, witness run directory and modules); still missing per the runtime audit: B base-learner files for every chain containing B, the INC stored-income-score mirror files (income teacher, JOINT / LOCAL E20), both SOURCE_ADMISSION.json records; proposed_ohn_deploy.patch (re-based on 5fb9d494a) closes them

findings.finding: manifests hash mutable non-functional files (VERIFY.json in every run directory; EVAL_MS.json / VERIFY.json in the anchor mirror directory); A, B, INC and PROT verify overwrite VERIFY.json, so a verify after a build makes the package unloadable (fail-closed). A package built while its module is being edited goes stale the same way (observed: ohn/protect.py edited 07:08:47Z, 3 s after a review build).
findings.required_fix: exclude VERIFY*/EVAL_* from deps; build packages only from committed code after the stage is frozen
findings.status: mitigated by process (coordinator: packages built only after the last verify); VERIFY*.json still hashed (excluded by the proposed patch)

findings.finding: verify writes the private record even when verification fails and refuses any second verification (write-once): one failed attempt (e.g. before the push is visible) permanently blocks dev_report_truth unless a private file is deleted by hand. verify also does not compare the published blob ids with the local files (checked here: all five registration files identical).
findings.required_fix: write the record only on success (log failures separately) and compare blob ids

findings.finding: with psutil importable (the .venv interpreter has it) _peak_rss_loop blocks until the child exits, so max_wall_s is never enforced (Homebrew python3, used for every wrapper so far, lacks psutil: sampled_peak_rss is null for every unit); refusals (window, budget, RSS, duplicate id) leave no ledger record; id uniqueness is checked only against finished units; a killed waiter whose PID is reused would block the FIFO head.
findings.required_fix: bound the sampler loop by max_wall_s; log refusals; check running ids

findings.finding: the B, C and PROT predict functions do not check their parameter file (STATE.json / PARAMS.json) against the release record. PROT writes THETA.npz / CODEBOOK.npz and PARAMS.json (scale, witness) AFTER save_occupation, so OCC.json records none of them; outside a package nothing pins the release strength (PARAMS.json pins THETA / CODEBOOK). The family verify and the package manifest do catch a change.
findings.required_fix: write PARAMS / THETA / CODEBOOK before save_occupation and record their hashes in OCC.json; check them (and B STATE.json, C PARAMS.json) in predict
findings.status: open; proposed_ohn_fam_b.patch adds the STATE.json check to fam_b.predict (demonstrated: fam_b_state_test.py)
